dishes.name: Gelibolu cheese halva
dishes.desc: A sweet-salty halva made from fresh unsalted white cheese, a little flour and beet sugar, with a geographical indication. Gelibolu makers trace it back some 700 years.

dishes.name: Ezine cheese
dishes.desc: A white brine cheese named for the Ezine district, a fixture of Turkish breakfast and an ingredient in many local dishes. Easy to buy across the province.

dishes.name: Gelibolu sardines
dishes.desc: Sardines from the Gelibolu coast, salted and cured or cooked as buğulama and stuffed dolma. Salted fish canning is part of the town's food identity.

dishes.name: Gelibolu chicken mantı
dishes.desc: A chicken-topped mantı dish listed among Gelibolu's signature foods in local culinary research. It sits beside the cheese halva and sardines as the town's own table.
